name: claude-toolkit
description: A general-use toolkit of Claude Code plugins by jahirtrap: mods, MCP servers, skills and commands, each installed on its own.

plugins.name: chess
plugins.description: Chess against Claude in a pane, any time, without taking a chat turn: click a piece and its square, Claude thinks and answers in a few seconds. English and Spanish.

plugins.name: meowzik
plugins.description: A music player beside the chat, after the Meowzik Discord bot: YouTube, SoundCloud, Spotify and Suno, a queue, history and favorites with no limits, loop, shuffle, autoplay, volume and seeking. Claude can play and control it too, and it installs mpv and yt-dlp when they are missing.
